title: Price Columns for Professional Email Term Renewals
content:
**Rule.** The price column of a Professional Email term renewal is read from the billing plan and the calendar months of the term: on the annual-billed-monthly plan, a 12-month term billed monthly, it is the annual-billed-monthly column; on the monthly plan, a term of one calendar month, it is the month-to-month column, priced above the annual commitment; otherwise it is the annual-commitment column. The plan seat price of the term renewal is the seat price in that column.

**Seat prices held for term renewals, USD per seat per month.**

| Product | Annual commitment | Annual billed monthly | Month-to-month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 1.99 | — | 2.49 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 3.99 | — | 4.99 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 5.99 | — | 7.49 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 6.00 | 6.30 | 7.20 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 12.50 | 13.13 | 15.00 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 22.00 | 23.10 | 26.40 |

The Harborline Mail products have no annual-billed-monthly price.

Example (hypothetical): a Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription on the annual-billed-monthly plan over a 12-month term renews at 23.10 per seat; the same product on the monthly plan over a one-month term renews at 26.40.
